'''Kiffu''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the outermost reaches of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Do you remember lightning season on Kiffu, when the static trees take to the air?|[[Larin Moxla]], to [[Shigar Konshi]]|<ref name="TOR:FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Kiffu.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The surface of Kiffu.]]
Kiffu was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]], a [[Near-Human]] species known to maintain their independence vigorously.<ref name="TCSWE" />

Kiffu was the larger sister world of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]].<ref name="Wizards" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> When the two worlds' elliptical [[Orbit/Legends|orbits]] would bring them close together, large electrical storms would be generated in Kiffu's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] harnessed the lightning to provide electrical energy.<ref name="Wizards" />

==History==
Sometime after [[3653 BBY]] the planet was forcefully [[Annexation of Kiffu|annexed]] into the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. It was one of the many planets that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had to withdraw from due to the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Many Kiffar escaped into Republic space. Some of them joined the Republic forces to liberate their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="TOR:FA" /> Sometime after the fall of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Kiffu once again became part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[File:Sheyf_Tinte_on_Throne.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sheyf Tinté negotiates with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on Kiffu.]]
Kiffu was ruled by the [[Sheyf]]s of [[Clan Vos]] from [[331 BBY]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the planet was [[Raid on Kiffu|conquered]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Over the years, many [[energy spider]]s were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] onto the planet from Kessel.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Contrary to official map placements, ''Star Wars: Republic: Darkness'' place Kiffu in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
